Q: How can I make a fixed width mutliline table in vim/neovim? A:

table.vim is a table editing plugin that supports fixed width multiline rows. The basic usage is to type out a table with pipes (|) and dashes (-) and the plugin aligns the table on pipe insertion. Fixed width columns are denoted by a row containing only tags of the form <number>. To re-flow the text you probably want to use the paragraph_wrap formatting option. With that setting, the following table

| <4> | <31> | <36> |
|---|------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|   | Visual                                         | Audio                                                                      |
|---|------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| 1 | Spokesperson speaking to camera                | "This graph shows us that there was a sharp increase in sales in Q3..."    |
|   |                                                |                                                                            |
|   | Image next to speaker: Sales graph             |                                                                            |
|   |                                                |                                                                            |
|---|------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| 2 | Spokesperson speaking to camera                | "...and this pie chart may hold the key to understanding why."             |
|   |                                                |                                                                            |
|   | Image next to speaker: Pie chart               |                                                                            |
|   |                                                |                                                                            |
|---|------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| 3 | Spokesperson speaking to camera                | "As it turns out our video marketing efforts in Q2 made a big difference." |
|   |                                                |                                                                            |
|   | Text above image of pie chart: VIDEO MARKETING |                                                                            |
|   |                                                |                                                                            |
|---|------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------|

would be formatted to the table in the posted example script link:

|------|---------------------------------|--------------------------------------|
| <4>  | <31>                            | <36>                                 |
|------|---------------------------------|--------------------------------------|
|      | Visual                          | Audio                                |
|------|---------------------------------|--------------------------------------|
| 1    | Spokesperson speaking to camera | "This graph shows us that there was  |
|      |                                 | a sharp increase in sales in Q3..."  |
|      | Image next to speaker: Sales    |                                      |
|      | graph                           |                                      |
|      |                                 |                                      |
|------|---------------------------------|--------------------------------------|
| 2    | Spokesperson speaking to camera | "...and this pie chart may hold the  |
|      |                                 | key to understanding why."           |
|      | Image next to speaker: Pie      |                                      |
|      | chart                           |                                      |
|      |                                 |                                      |
|------|---------------------------------|--------------------------------------|
| 3    | Spokesperson speaking to camera | "As it turns out our video marketing |
|      |                                 | efforts in Q2 made a big             |
|      | Text above image of pie chart:  | difference."                         |
|      | VIDEO MARKETING                 |                                      |
|      |                                 |                                      |
|------|---------------------------------|--------------------------------------|

With the table style option set to single, the table would be drawn with single-lined box drawing characters.
